source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Network Performance' (PDF 19): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Network performance ka matlab hai network kitna achha kaam karta hai. Yeh data transfer ki speed aur quality (miyar) dikhati hai. Achhi performance tez aur smooth (baghair rukawat) communication deti hai. Poor (kharab) performance se internet slow hota hai aur delays (deri) hoti hain. Network performance kai factors (wajuhat) par depend karti hai, jaise bandwidth aur latency.

blocks.prompt: Network performance kin do bari cheezon par depend karti hai?
blocks.explanation: Bandwidth aur latency (aur kai doosre factors).

items: Performance: data transfer ki speed aur quality; bandwidth aur latency par depend.
